steps.say: A testicular mass is removed through the groin. Radical inguinal orchiectomy is performed with the cord clamped early. High ligation is placed at the internal inguinal ring. Scrotal skin is never divided across the tumour. Needle biopsy through the scrotum is banned outright. Prosthesis counselling is offered before surgery.
steps.tx: **Radical inguinal orchiectomy** (groin removal of testis and cord) with high cord ligation at the **internal ring** (deep groin opening) is mandatory for suspected tumours. **Scrotal violation** (cutting through scrotal skin) or trans-scrotal biopsy is banned, because it seeds new lymphatic routes. Clamp the cord early before mobilizing the testis, because manipulation sheds tumour cells.

steps.say: Blood markers are staged and followed in germ cell tumours. Alpha fetoprotein is tracked with a half life of five to seven days. Beta hCG is watched with a half life of twenty four to thirty six hours. LDH is added as a less specific tissue marker. Rising levels after orchiectomy prove residual disease. Falling curves are plotted against the known half lives.
steps.tx: **Alpha-fetoprotein** (yolk sac marker) with a **half-life** (clearance time) of **5 to 7 days** (five to seven days), **beta-hCG** (placental marker) with **24 to 36 hours** (twenty four to thirty six hours), and LDH stage and track germ cell tumours. Draw markers before orchiectomy and repeat on schedule, because half life mathematics separates persistence from new growth. Rising markers after surgery prove residual disease.

steps.say: AFP is trusted to settle the seminoma question decisively every time. Pure seminoma is staged as never raising AFP. Pure choriocarcinoma is grouped the same way. AFP elevation in presumed seminoma is relabelled as NSGCT. Such cases are managed as non seminomatous tumours. Chemotherapy is planned by NSGCT protocols afterwards.
steps.tx: **Pure seminoma** (uniform germ tumour) never shows **AFP elevation** (raised yolk sac marker), and neither does pure choriocarcinoma. AFP rise in a presumed seminoma mandates **NSGCT** (non seminomatous) management with NSGCT chemotherapy. Recut the pathology and restage before treatment, because seminoma protocols undertreat yolk sac elements.

vis.alt: Gross specimen of seminomatous testicular tumour.
vis.caption: Pure seminoma: AFP rise relabels the case as NSGCT. Credit: StewardMD.

steps.say: Testicular lymphatics are traced along the gonadal vessels upward. Right sided tumours are drained to interaortocaval nodes. Left sided tumours are sent to para-aortic nodes. The left landing zone sits near the renal hilum. Scrotal skin is drained to groin nodes instead. Inguinal nodes are involved only after scrotal violation.
steps.tx: **Lymphatic drainage** (node landing zones) of the right testis runs to **interaortocaval nodes** (between aorta and vena cava), while the left testis drains to **para-aortic nodes** (beside the aorta) near the left renal hilum. These templates shape RPLND boundaries on each side. Scrotal violation reroutes drainage to inguinal nodes, because scrotal skin belongs to a different watershed.

steps.say: RPLND is feared to threaten ejaculation through nerve injury. Postganglionic sympathetic fibres are traced with the hypogastric plexus. Fibres from L1 to L3 are wired for antegrade emission. Nerve sparing templates are mapped to preserve these strands. Antegrade ejaculation is maintained in most preserved cases. Fertility counselling is completed before surgery.
steps.tx: **Nerve-sparing RPLND** (ejaculation preserving node clearance) saves postganglionic sympathetic fibres of the **hypogastric plexus** (pelvic nerve mesh) from **L1 to L3** (first to third lumbar) to keep **antegrade ejaculation** (forward semen flow). Map templates to spare these strands while clearing disease. Bank sperm before any RPLND or chemotherapy, because rescue cannot restore lost emission.

steps.say: Chemotherapy leaves lumps that must be judged. Residual NSGCT masses above one cm are treated as teratoma. Normal markers are trusted not to guarantee dead tissue. Viable cancer is hidden in a substantial minority. Complete surgical excision is ordered for every such mass. Pathology of the removed lump directs further therapy.
steps.tx: **Residual mass** (leftover lump) above **1 cm** (one centimetre) after chemotherapy for NSGCT with normalized markers mandates **post-chemotherapy RPLND** (completion node surgery), because **teratoma** (differentiated germ tumour) or viable cancer hides inside. Resect completely with bilateral template discipline. Let pathology steer further chemotherapy, because growing teratoma ignores drugs.

vis.alt: Gross specimen of post chemotherapy testicular teratoma.
vis.caption: Post chemotherapy residue above one cm: resect for teratoma. Credit: StewardMD.

steps.say: Seminoma residues are managed more gently than NSGCT. Masses under three cm are watched with serial scans. Larger residues are kept for metabolic proof of cure. FDG PET CT is scheduled at least six to eight weeks after chemotherapy. Earlier scans are distorted falsely by inflammation. Positive hotspots are biopsied or resected promptly.
steps.tx: **Post-chemo seminoma** (treated seminoma residue) under **3 cm** (three centimetres) is watched, while masses of 3 cm or more need **FDG PET-CT** (metabolic scan) at least **6 to 8 weeks** (six to eight weeks) after chemotherapy to prove cure. Scan earlier and inflammation glows falsely. Resect or biopsy avid hotspots, because viable seminoma still cures with salvage therapy.

steps.say: Metastatic germ tumours are grouped by outlook at diagnosis. IGCCCG criteria are applied using site, spread, and markers. Good risk disease is cured in the vast majority. Intermediate risk is given intensified drug courses. Poor risk disease is sent to expert centres. Marker nadir with primary site is banded together.
steps.tx: **IGCCCG criteria** (germ tumour outlook score) sort metastatic disease into good, intermediate, and poor **prognostic groups** (cure likelihood bands) from primary site, metastases, and marker nadir. Good risk cures with standard chemotherapy while poor risk needs intensified expert care. Reclassify after orchiectomy markers settle, because the nadir defines the band.

vis.caption: Germ cell pathology: IGCCCG groups set chemotherapy intensity. Credit: StewardMD.
